posts.caption:
Our latest Broadcast Lab commission comes from maji.amu, a Lamu-based collective founded in 2024 by _.nelima aka MSBHVR.

Meaning water in Swahili, MAJI is creating space for artists to experiment with Kenyan coastal influences and local electronic sounds on their own terms. From taarab and Mugithi to Mwanzele mixed with Jungle.

Swipe to read _.nelima’s mission statement for the project, and watch the full stream on Thursday 12 November from 14:00 GMT / 17:00 EAT via the link in bio.
